glosses: gym (sporting facility specialized for lifting weights and exercise)

examples.en: He could be in the gymnasium.

examples.text: Eu não fui ao ginásio esta semana.
examples.en: I haven't been to the gym this week.
The girls danced in the gym.

examples.text: Sinto muito, mas tenho de ir ao ginásio.
examples.en: I'm sorry, but I have to go to the gym.

examples.text: Conheci minha namorada atual no ginásio.
examples.en: I met my current girlfriend in high school.
